name: Nowhere Expeditions (the Company)
extraRule: After each expedition you take part in, gain +1 Coin (added after your Resources refresh).

name: University of Verna
extraRule: Once between expeditions, when you make a Research Project Action, gain +1 additional Progress if the University's laboratories, archives, specialists or equipment could reasonably assist you.

name: Independent
extraRule: Once between expeditions, when you make a Personal Project Action, gain +1 additional Progress.

name: Vardic Holds
extraRule: Once per session, when you Create an Advantage using **Crafts** by repairing, reinforcing, modifying or improvising equipment, you may treat a tie as a success with one free invoke instead.

name: Aurelian Empire
extraRule: Once per session, bring one item from your Personal Stash into action without paying the normal Stress or Fate Point cost.

name: Vesper Republic
extraRule: Once per session, establish that your sponsor or one of its affiliated societies provided a reasonable, useful contact relevant to the problem: information, an introduction or limited assistance. The contact can't solve the main problem for you.

name: Kharad Compact
extraRule: An extra Mild Consequence slot, **Minor Obligation**: instead of paying up to 2 Coins, someone covers the cost and you record the debt. You clear it by completing a Project and offering its result to the Kharad Compact.

name: Tianzhao Mandate
extraRule: Once between expeditions, when you make progress on a Recovery Project for one of your own Consequences, gain +1 additional Progress.
